Moonshot (Kimi) is supposedly shopping 8,000+ Nvidia Blackwell GPUs in Europe. Not to ship boxes into China. To rent the login.

US export controls block the hardware. They don't block a European neocloud from selling FLOPs over the wire. Moonshot reportedly offered 30–50% higher

#China’s new export controls signal a shift from selling technology to controlling who can replicate it. By restricting the transfer of #AI, biomedicine, and solar manufacturing know-how, Beijing can preserve its industrial lead while continuing to sell the products: Manoj Joshi
